incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert: increased fallback churn and regional latencies for inference-route /v1/chat across eu-west + us-east. Oncall: Liam O'Connor. See /incidents/2112223333.
Liam O'Connor: I'm on it. Dashboard shows repeated retry cycles: client sessions get routed eu-west -> us-east -> eu-west within seconds. 5xx spike ~9%.
Sofia Perez: grabbing the router trace for a sample session id s_7b2d. Policy evaluation shows preferred eu-west with variant weights {alpha:0.95, beta:0.05} but fallback mapping has `beta` flagged as incompatible for content-type application/json+structured which returns 415 leading to immediate retry.
Liam O'Connor: That mismatch looks like the rollout config change from 02:50 UTC. Who merged that? @Sofia any PR ID?
Sofia Perez: PR #4923 merged at 02:49 by infra-deploy-bot. The rollout included a new `sticky_variant_ttl_ms:0` which disables session stickiness temporarily. That + fallback on error causes rapid bouncing.
CS - Hana: We're getting live tickets from two accounts in eu-west complaining about mid-response resets and slow token streaming.
Liam O'Connor: We need a fast mitigation. Options: 1) pin a safe variant in eu-west for affected customers, 2) enable short stickiness, 3) revert rollout. Revert may take longer.
Sofia Perez: I'm applying a customer-scoped pin to stop the loop for the most impacted tenant (tenant:zenhealth).
Sofia Perez: Command:
```
rwctl overrides apply --scope tenant:zenhealth --region eu-west --variant gpt-redwood-v1-stable --duration 600 --reason "stop fallback churn"
```
Sofia Perez: Applied. Observed immediate reduction in retries for zenhealth. Overall error rate decreased to ~4% but some tenants still experiencing schema errors.
Liam O'Connor: Did the pinned variant support the structured output contract? If not, we may be trading churn for schema regressions.
Sofia Perez: Correct — v1-stable expects `output.v1` format; the experimental variant returns `output.v2` for some routes. A subset of sessions now see parse errors.
ops-runner: Note: when applying region pins, remember inference cache keys and session sticky entries persist until TTL. If you revoke a pin, clients might still hold stale sticky keys.
Liam O'Connor: Good call. For quick containment: apply tenant-scoped pin for those with highest error rates, leave others on flow with increased stickiness to avoid bounce. Also set short sticky_ttl_ms to 30000 to reduce long-term drift.
Sofia Perez: Executing stickiness change:
```
rwctl routing update --policy-id r_203 --set sticky_variant_ttl_ms=30000
```
Sofia Perez: Patch applied. Monitoring now.
CS - Hana: Confirming zenhealth reporting sessions are stable. Other customers still seeing occasional resets.
Liam O'Connor: I'm going to revoke the broad region pin that some engineer applied earlier (it was causing schema mismatch at scale).
Sofia Perez: Which override id? I see `ovr_eu_9987` was region-wide pin. Revoke it now.
Sofia Perez: `rwctl overrides revoke --id ovr_eu_9987` -> accepted.
ops-runner: Flushing session sticky cache for eu-west and targeted tenants to ensure no stale pointers:
```
rw-cache purge --scope region:eu-west --prefix sticky --confirm
rw-cache purge --scope tenant:zenhealth --prefix sticky --confirm
```
ops-runner: Purge completed. Note: rolling revokes can create short windows where new requests evaluate policy and may re-enter fallback; we should watch.
Liam O'Connor: Logs show retries dropping and median latency improving. 5xx back to baseline in last 6m.
Sofia Perez: There are still a few outliers where sessions retained old sticky key from client-side cookies pointing to the experimental variant. For those, we're expiring session tokens older than 1h.
Sofia Perez: `sessions expire --region eu-west --age_gt 3600 --confirm` -> executed.
CS - Hana: Customers confirming improvements. One customer noted a single degraded conversation but otherwise ok.
Liam O'Connor: Good. For post-incident actions: 1) Add CI validation that rollout JSON cannot set stable fallback weight to zero and must validate content-type compat matrix; 2) Update runbook: when performing region-scoped pins, always purge sticky caches and document sticky TTL race; 3) Add telemetry alert: variant returns non-200 or 4xx for >5% of requests in 2 min -> auto-dampen weight by 50% before manual pin.
Sofia Perez: I'll own the validation and the compatibility matrix work. ops-runner please add cache-purge step to the emergency pin playbook.
ops-runner: Will do, adding a section and test for `rw-cache purge` in the playbook.
incident-bot: Incident resolved by Liam O'Connor. Severity: P1 -> resolved. Timeline: 2112223333 - 2112223999. Postmortem required: /postmortems/2112223333.
Liam O'Connor: Handing follow-ups to Sofia and ops-runner. I'll monitor for one hour then clear oncall. :thumbsup:
